trip.checklistDisclaimer: Rules change — always check official sources before you travel.

checklist.passportGenericDesc: Check your travel document is valid for the whole trip.
checklist.passportDesc: Many countries ask for a passport valid at least 6 months after you arrive.
checklist.passportSchengenDesc: Must be valid 3+ months after you leave the Schengen area and issued within the last 10 years.
checklist.passportEuDesc: EU/EEA and Swiss citizens can travel with a valid national ID card or passport.
checklist.eesDesc: Non-EU visitors give fingerprints and a photo at the border on their first entry.
checklist.etiasDesc: Visa-free visitors (e.g. US, UK, Canada, Australia) need an ETIAS once it launches. Others need a Schengen visa.
checklist.estaDesc: Visa Waiver citizens (most of the EU, the UK, Australia, Japan…) apply online at least 72 hours before flying. Everyone else needs a US visitor visa.
checklist.usVisaDesc: Your country isn't in the US Visa Waiver Program, so you'll most likely need a B-2 visitor visa. Apply early, appointments can take months.
checklist.ukEtaDesc: Most visitors who don't need a visa, including EU citizens, need an Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) before travelling.
checklist.caEtaDesc: Visa-exempt visitors flying in need an eTA. Others need a visitor visa.
checklist.auEtaDesc: Everyone except New Zealanders needs a visa or travel authority before flying to Australia.
checklist.doEticketDesc: Every traveller fills in the free online e-Ticket before arriving and again before leaving. Show the QR code at the airport.
checklist.entryCheckDesc: Check whether you need a visa or travel authorisation for {country} with your government's travel advice.
checklist.currencyDesc: Bring a card that works abroad without fees, plus a little cash for tips and small purchases.
checklist.plugDesc: Bring an adapter if your plugs are different.
checklist.plugVoltageDesc: The power here is {volts} V, yours is {homeVolts} V. Phone and laptop chargers usually handle both, but hair dryers and straighteners may not.
checklist.timezoneDesc: {offset} on the wedding day. Plan for jet lag if it's far from home.
checklist.emergencyDesc: Save it in your phone before you go.
checklist.insuranceDesc: Get travel insurance that covers medical care abroad.
checklist.insuranceEhicDesc: Bring your European Health Insurance Card. Travel insurance is still a good idea.
